hints.title: Pen Count Iteration
hints.text: Iterate over all possible numbers of pens bought: 0 <= num_pens <= total // cost1.

hints.title: Remaining Budget Division
hints.text: With num_pens pens purchased, remaining budget is rem = total - num_pens * cost1.

hints.title: Pencil Choices Combination
hints.text: You can buy anywhere from 0 up to rem // cost2 pencils, contributing (rem // cost2 + 1) distinct choices.

hints.title: Linear Combinations Sum

complexity.notes: Iterates through possible pen counts up to total // cost1.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested loops testing all pen and pencil combinations take O((total/cost1) * (total/cost2)) operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate fixes one item count and computes the other via integer division.
